title.purpose: Editable demand title in the detail panel.

wordmark.purpose: Lowercase "lumo" beside the logo mark only.

item.purpose: Demand titles in rows (550) and cards (600); capture input.

body.purpose: Base text, ledes, notes (1.6 in notes and AI text).

control.purpose: Buttons (600); menu items and project filters at 500.

label.purpose: Field labels, tags and chips (550), AI pill.

meta.purpose: Sequence numbers, count badges, card headers, section titles.

shadows.name: sh-1 rest
shadows.purpose: Cards, row containers, capture field, active view item, theme toggle.

shadows.name: sh-3 float
shadows.purpose: Account menu, projects popover, toasts, sheets, auth card.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on inputs, capture, search, selected card; arrive animation start.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only curve; soft ease-out for every transition and animation.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color, border, shadow and opacity changes; toast leave.

motion.name: pop-menu
motion.purpose: Menu pop in: fade, 4px rise, 0.98 scale.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Toasts, sheets, AI box; card lift, checkbox fill, search width, strength bars.

motion.name: finish
motion.purpose: Completed row or card fades and slides 14px right at 0.985 scale.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: New demand drops in from 6px above at 0.99 scale with the accent ring fading.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions collapse to 1ms.

breakpoints.name: rail
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes a 68px icon rail; projects popover; search collapses; detail overlays.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.purpose: Card actions always visible, in flow.

theming.attribute: data-theme on <html>: "dark" forces dark, "light" forces light, absent follows prefers-color-scheme.
theming.toggle: 38px theme button with Lucide moon (light) / sun (dark); flips the effective theme, persists it, tells the desktop shell, repaints when the host page changes data-theme.

brand.mark: Rounded teal square (rx = 1/4 side), thick white rounded L, amber light dot top right. Flat in app (src/renderer/assets/mark.svg); gradient #1f9a86 to #106456 with amber glow in build/icon.svg.

extensions.iconography: Lucide (ISC), inline SVG, stroke 1.6, round caps and joins, currentColor; 16px default, 12-14px in chips and small buttons, 18px in navigation and the theme toggle.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Quiet Desk"**

Lumo is a clean, minimalist workspace that recedes so the demands and their state carry the screen. A tinted, almost-white ground holds white surfaces drawn with 1px hairlines, softly rounded corners and shallow two-layer shadows. One pine-teal accent marks what the user can act on, what is selected, what has focus and what is in progress; red, amber, blue and green appear only where they mean something (overdue, due today or high, waiting, done). Everything else is a teal-leaning gray.

Density is calm-dense: a 1280x820 window holds the sidebar, the capture field, the in-progress cards and the overdue / due-today / urgent groups without scrolling. Groups are single rounded containers with hairline-divided rows, not stacks of floating cards. Type is Figtree alone, with tabular numerals everywhere so counts, sequence numbers and ages align. Icons are Lucide line icons at a 1.6 stroke, inline SVG in `currentColor`.

Motion is short and purposeful: completing a demand fills the round checkbox with the accent and the row slides out (260ms); a new demand arrives with a soft accent ring (320ms); everything else is a 160-200ms state change on one ease-out curve. Lumo ships a light and a dark theme with an explicit toggle; both are complete token sets.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted neutral ground (pine-teal leaning grays), white surfaces, 1px hairlines.
One accent: pine teal for action, selection, focus and in-progress.
Status color reserved for meaning: red overdue/urgent, amber due-today/high, blue waiting, green done.
Figtree only, tabular numerals on by default.
Four radii (8/10/14/18px) plus full pills and circles for chips, badges and checkboxes.
Light and dark themes, user-selectable, following the system until chosen.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Pine teal is the only accent. It marks primary action, selection, focus, in-progress and completion; it never decorates a heading, a divider or an empty area.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, blue and green appear only when a demand is overdue/urgent, due today/high, waiting or done. A status color without a status behind it is a bug.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every gray leans toward the accent hue (OKLCH hue 165-182, with the accent at 178). Stock zinc, slate or pure-gray neutrals do not belong in Lumo.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Figtree sets everything, including keyboard hints and codes. Hierarchy comes from weight and a 1-2px size step, not from a second family.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on the document; counts, sequence numbers (#31), ages (5h, 2d) and dates line up in columns.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px hairline and a value step before reaching for shadow. Rows inside a container are divided by hairlines, never by gaps and per-row shadows.

rules.name: The Float-Only-When-Floating Rule
rules.body: The Float shadow belongs to things above the page (menus, toasts, sheets, the auth card). Content at rest takes Rest; Lift is a response to hover or to the detail panel's open state.

rules.name: The Four Radii Rule
rules.body: Corners come from 8/10/14/18px, pills and circles. Nesting steps down: an 18px panel holds 14px containers, which hold 10px and 8px controls.

dos: Do use Pine Teal for the one primary action on a surface, the selection, focus and in-progress state, and nothing else.
Do pair every status fill with its own text step (`danger-soft` with `danger-text`, and so on) so chips stay AA in both themes.
Do group lists as one rounded container (14px) with 1px hairline rows.
Do set every value from tokens so both themes stay complete: a new color needs a light and a dark value under `:root` and `[data-theme="dark"]`.
Do use Lucide icons as inline SVG at a 1.6 stroke in `currentColor`, 16px by default, 12-14px inside chips and small buttons, 18px in navigation.
Do keep numbers tabular and keyboard hints visible next to the actions they trigger.
Do honor reduced motion and keep the finish (260ms) and arrive (320ms) moments as the only expressive motion.
donts: Don't use red, amber, blue or green for decoration, categories or emphasis; they mean overdue/urgent, due-today/high, waiting and done.
Don't introduce untinted grays, a second accent, or the logo's amber as a UI color.
Don't add a second typeface or monospace for codes and shortcuts; Figtree sets everything.
Don't use radii outside 8/10/14/18px, pills and circles for new surfaces.
Don't put the Float shadow on content at rest or stack per-row shadows inside a group container.
Don't write the wordmark capitalized or recolor the logo mark.
